conversations.title: Parkinson’s drastically changed how they have sex. They're not alone.
conversations.reply: Disabled people have sex lives, and the only shock is that anyone finds it a shock. This app was built to close the gap between silence and acceptance.

conversations.title: Forget Tinder: LinkedIn is the new place to find love
conversations.reply: Ableism is rampant in dating, with disabled people facing endless rejection. Mainstream platforms claim inclusivity, but the evidence says otherwise.

conversations.title: FCM Travel caution over accessibility of new digital arrival cards
conversations.reply: Digital systems must prioritize accessibility, not just convenience. Disabled travelers deserve equal access, not excuses or afterthoughts.

conversations.title: The founder of Hinge raised $18M to build a new AI dating service, Overtone
conversations.reply: New dating apps rarely address ableism and exclusion. Able2Love exists because mainstream platforms failed to prioritize accessibility and inclusivity.

conversations.title: Leeds Pride 2026 Set to Draw 60,000 as City Marks 20 Years of Celebration
conversations.reply: Pride events must be accessible, not just tokenistically so. A Pride that excludes disabled people isn't a Pride, it's a party with a door policy.

conversations.title: Elle King Shares How Autism Diagnosis Changed Her Life
conversations.reply: Autism diagnoses bring new challenges in dating. Disabled people deserve respect, understanding, and inclusion in all aspects of life, including dating.

conversations.title: Column | Asking Eric: Neighbors react badly to person with autism disorder
conversations.reply: Ableism is a societal problem that requires a societal solution, starting with education, empathy, and inclusivity. Disabled people face exclusion everywhere, including dating.

conversations.title: Molly Burke
conversations.reply: Molly Burke's work challenges ableist norms and advocates for disability rights. Disabled people deserve respect, inclusion, and equal opportunities in all aspects of life.

target_reply: Able2Love exists to challenge ableism in dating. We'd like to discuss disability representation and dating with you, as a prominent advocate for disability rights.
funding: Nothing new today, but UnLtd (unltd.org.uk), Access to Work (gov.uk), and the Stelios Awards (around March) are still available for disability-focused initiatives.
moment: Able2Love exists because dating apps often neglect accessibility, leaving many people excluded from online matchmaking. This oversight is a common pattern. It highlights a need for inclusive platforms.
